item.title: [+1] India and Turkey propose ideas to resume Black Sea grain shipments, US says at G20
item.description:
Black Sea attacks have made it deadlier than Hormuz; Türkiye submitted proposals to the US and others call for a truce. Builds on last week's corridor proposal.

Agri & fertilisers: mild tailwind (+1) — Cheaper grain inputs

Why it matters: Restored Black Sea flows would ease world grain and edible oil prices, helping India's food inflation.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook +1

Confidence: low · horizon: months
